guidetextdraw_1753911730._value:
Documentation of COVID-19 Vaccination and/or Test Result

Valid examples of vaccination documentation include a COVID-19 Vaccination Record Card, QR Code from the State of California, or a letter from a healthcare provider.

To verify a COVID-19 test result, upload a photograph showing the test results and noting your name, time and date of the test.
